summary: Chassis kit for a small round differential-drive robot. It has a bumper skirt ring, a battery-holder base plate for four AAA cells with an integrated ball caster, two wheels with tires, two motor clips and loose battery contacts. The bounds describe the assembled chassis footprint, with the wheels at the sides.

mountingSurfaces.description: Battery holder base plate: flat floor with two AAA cell bays and rectangular slots and small holes. Control board and electronics would mount above it.
Side motor pockets at left and right of the base for the micro metal gearmotors, secured by the motor clips.

notes: No dimensions are given in the text except the 32×7 mm wheels, so the scale comes from them. The wheel diameter is about 1/3 of the chassis diameter in the photos, which suggests a chassis of roughly 95-100 mm. The z height of 30 mm is estimated from the assembled photo, with the skirt about 20-25 mm tall and the base and wheel clearance adding the rest. Small round holes in the battery plate are visible but their diameters and positions are not measurable, so none are listed. Wheel width of 7 mm and tire fit are not included in the overall x extent. Dimensions are unverified.
